sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the Petitioners and the State.

2. By means of this application, the Petitioners seek grant of bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. in apprehension of arrest for their alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 341/294/323/376(2)(n)/506/34, I.P.C. in connection with Chandaka P.S. Case No.139 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.657 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned J.M.F.C. (O), Bhubaneswar.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioners does not press this bail application in respect of Petitioner No.4 - Manoranjan Paltasingh @ Manas.
In view of such submission, the ABLAPL stands dismissed as not pressed so far as Petitioner No.4 is concerned.

4. So far as Petitioner Nos.1, 2 & 3 namely Sina Bahubalendra @ Dali, Sujata Pradhan @ Mali @
Milli, & Swarnalata Rout @ Chain are concerned, having regard to the nature of the allegations, the seriousness and gravity of the offences and the facts and circumstances of the case, while this court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed that in the event Petitioner Nos.1, 2 and 3 surrender and move for bail before the learned J.M.F.C. (O), Bhubaneswar in G.R. Case No.657 of 2023 within a period of three weeks from today, they shall be allowed to go on bail on such terms and conditions as would be deemed just and proper by the said court, but subject to verification of criminal antecedents of the Petitioners.
5. If it is found that there is any other criminal antecedent to the credit of Petitioner Nos.1, 2 & 3 besides the present issue, this order shall not be given effect to.
